default/30925.htm.text: High Priestess Morelyn: Welcome! I am Morelyn, the high priestess of Eva. I supervise the priests in this temple. We have plenty of space here. If you wish to stay and rest for a while you are welcome.

default/30925-1.htm.text: High Priestess Morelyn: I act as the eyes and ears of the goddess in this land. She has given me the power to view, within the waterscape in this temple, everything that is happening in the waters of Innadril. What Fafurion and his minions are up to, that is my main concern.

Q00237_WindsOfChange/30925-01.html.text: High Priestess Morelyn: What brings you here, traveler? I can sense that you are not here for spiritual renewal. Why has Eva brought you to us?

Q00237_WindsOfChange/30925-04.html.text: High Priestess of Eva Morelyn: You have not left yet? I tell you this again. Please think about the meaning of this place Heine.

Q00237_WindsOfChange/30925-02.html.text: High Priestess Morelyn: Ahh, Athenia. I assume you are speaking of the Priestess that fights to ensure the sanctity and preservation of our lands. She is going to be our savior, you know.

links.text: "Although I can already see where your inclinations lie, I've come to solicit your opinion of her."

Q00237_WindsOfChange/30925-03.html.text: High Priestess Morelyn: Nature is the lifeblood of everyone and everything. The land will only nurture us so long as we nurture it. Athenia understands this and strives protect this delicate balance. And she is willing to do that by any means necessary. And for that, she has my unwaivering support.
